ContractScribe github-proposal

Usage:
  contract-scribe github-proposal start --repository-root <path> --input <path> --policy <path> --request <path> [--configuration <path>] [--configuration-override <path>]
  contract-scribe github-proposal resume --repository-root <path> --input <path> --policy <path> --request <path> [--configuration <path>] [--configuration-override <path>]

Options:
  --repository-root <path>       Existing repository root.
  --input <path>                 Existing .sln, .slnx, or .csproj inside the repository.
  --policy <path>                Existing M1 policy file inside the repository.
  --request <path>               Strict non-secret github-proposal invocation request JSON.
  --configuration <path>         Optional consumer configuration layer.
  --configuration-override <path>  Optional invocation configuration layer.
  -h, --help                     Print this help.

The four required options must appear exactly once; the two configuration layers are optional.
Both --option value and --option=value forms are accepted in any order.

Environment:
  CONTRACTSCRIBE_PROVIDER_API_KEY  Existing campaign provider credential.
  CONTRACTSCRIBE_GITHUB_TOKEN      GitHub credential read once after local publication admission.

Exit codes:
  0  Published, replayed, no work, awaiting review, or merged.
  2  Invalid command-line usage.
  3  Bounded resumable conflict, rate limit, or stale base after creation.
  4  Invalid state or authority, human change, permission failure, or closed unmerged.
  5  Host failure.
  6  Cancelled.
  7  Timeout.
